segments.text: As an operator or even a tour guide of a small shop like this,
segments.zh: 作为操作人员，甚至是像这样的小车间的参观向导，

segments.text: you want your customers to enjoy their experience out here.
segments.zh: 你希望你的客户在这里有愉快的体验，

segments.text: You want them to come home, talk to their friends and coworkers about what they saw today.
segments.zh: 希望他们回家后和朋友、同事聊聊今天看到的东西。

segments.text: You want to let them shoot videos and have fun of what they saw cut
segments.zh: 你希望让他们拍视频，开开心心地看切割过程，

segments.text: or come home with a trinket or something fun.
segments.zh: 或者带一件小饰品或好玩的东西回家。

segments.text: But you're still protecting them.
segments.zh: 但你仍然要保护他们，

segments.text: That's the biggest thing you're doing out here.
segments.zh: 这是你在这里要做的最重要的事情。

segments.text: You are showing off a little bit, but you're still watching out normally.
segments.zh: 你确实是在稍微展示一下，但平时仍然要留心照看。

segments.text: Someone is out here with a dresser trying to make sure that our eyes do stay clear.
segments.zh: 有人在这里带着护目装备，以确保我们的眼睛不受伤害。

segments.text: If they're out here with sandals or something like that,
segments.zh: 如果他们穿着凉鞋之类的来到这里，

segments.text: they're not going to be unloading steel with them around.
segments.zh: 有他们在旁边时，就不会卸钢材。

segments.text: Even with steel toes or composite toes, that's not a guarantee you're not going to get hurt.
segments.zh: 即使穿着钢头或复合材料护头的鞋，也不能保证你不会受伤。

segments.text: When you bring somebody out here that's dressed in what we call civilian clothes,
segments.zh: 当你带一个穿着我们所说的便装的人来到这里时，

segments.text: you want to be able to make sure that you take them where they're going to be safe.
segments.zh: 你要确保把他们带到安全的地方，

segments.text: Stand them where they can watch and still see that they're safe.
segments.zh: 让他们站在既能观看又安全的位置。

segments.text: And you watch them for just any of the things that might be,
segments.zh: 你要留意他们周围可能发生的任何情况，

segments.text: like if a tank is getting ready to lift or somebody's going to start a crash
segments.zh: 比如有罐体要吊起来，或者有人要启动起重机，

segments.text: or fire up a forklift or the human band's going to start.
segments.zh: 或者开动叉车，或者液压闸要启动。

segments.text: Some of that stuff surges and makes noises and they'll make them jump.
segments.zh: 其中有些东西会突然发力、发出噪声，会把他们吓一跳。

segments.text: So you talk to them. You talk to them about what you're about to do
segments.zh: 所以你要和他们沟通，告诉他们你接下来要做什么，

segments.text: and your point, it's going to come from here.
segments.zh: 以及你的重点：它会从这里过来，

segments.text: It's going to do this. They're not surprised.
segments.zh: 会这样动作。这样他们就不会被吓到。
